meta.coordinateSystem: top-left origin, x right, y down, pixels
meta.format: RGBA image source; transparency not verified
notes: Coordinates are approximate frame regions based on the rendered layout, not pixel-perfect alpha bounds.
Source includes a dark graphic background, titles and separators; rectangles are not clean transparent sprite exports.
Frame counts reflect visually estimated positions and may not match labels or distinct poses.
Directions are the labels printed on the source sheet; individual character facing orientations have not been validated.
